verdict.rationale: A state filing portal could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes showing bot walls (Akamai 403, Incapsula interstitials) and says nothing about any built-in assistant, so the verdict is none.
